title: Data-Parallel Finite-State Machines
venue: ASPLOS (Architectural Support for Programming Languages and Operating Systems)
relevance: Primary source. Introduces the enumerated-state technique for parallel FSM evaluation, with Huffman decoding as a key benchmark. Achieves 3x speedup on single core via SIMD.

title: Challenging the 'Embarrassingly Sequential': Parallelizing Finite State Machine-Based Computations through Principled Speculation
relevance: Complementary speculation-based approach to FSM parallelization. Provides probabilistic model for speculation accuracy.

title: Pipelined Parallel Finite Automata Evaluation
relevance: FPGA implementation of pipelined parallel NFA evaluation using the enumerated-state approach, achieving 47 GB/s throughput.

title: Parallel Prefix Computation
relevance: Foundational algorithm for parallel prefix computation that underpins the FSM composition approach.
